mcqs.q: When did Luther post the 95 Theses?
What is the problem of evil?
options: If God is all-loving, all-knowing and all-powerful, why does evil and suffering exist? Logically, all four cannot be true together without explanation.
Pelagius and Augustine agreed humans are born innocent.
It is the question of whether the devil really exists.
It is the question of whether evil people will go to hell.

mcqs.q: What is the doctrine of the Trinity?
options: God is one being existing in three persons (Father, Son, Holy Spirit) — distinct in person but united in essence; Christians remain monotheistic.
The Trinity refers to heaven, earth and hell.
Pelagius and Augustine agreed humans are born innocent.
Christians believe in three different gods.

mcqs.q: What was the Augustine vs Pelagius dispute about original sin?
options: The Trinity refers to heaven, earth and hell.
Original sin means Christians believe babies are evil.
Pelagius and Augustine agreed humans are born innocent.

Augustine argued humans inherit a corrupted nature from Adam (original sin) and cannot achieve salvation without grace; Pelagius argued humans retain free will to choose good without divine intervention and that sin is imitated, not inherited.
